title: Inexpensive, makes great coffee, great purchase!
text:
Inexpensive, makes great coffee, great purchase!. UPDATE--4/14/17
I took two stars away since apparently I am experiencing what many other reviewers had mentioned when machine stopped working. You can hear the brewer heating the water, and then the pump kicks on. However, nothing comes out. I've used distilled water since Day 1. Honestly I was uber happy with this machine however disappointed that this seems to be a reoccurring issue with this model. But it did last 5 years so I shouldn't complain. Trying to decide if I should just by a Keurig this time or take a chance another model of this Mr.Coffee machine.

I got this as a pre Black Friday Sale for only $49.99 off of Amazon (regularly $89 or $99). I absolutely love it! Ton of my friends and family have a Keurig so I was hesitant in buying this versus a Keurig itself. I am so glad I didn't. This machine does the same trick as the regular Keruig machine. It comes with a reservoir like the traditional Keurig machine which is on the back top side versus on the side. The reservoir isn't a large as some of the Keurig's come with but it easily will make three large cups before needing to be refilled. This isn't a huge deal since I am the only one who drinks coffee in my house. I've had no problems with leaking. I use distilled water which I've been told helps keep the machine clean and running better. The other good thing and one of my main requirements was that the tray pulls out so i can fit a travel cup since I often take my coffee to go. Some of my travel mugs don't fit but the standard and the majority of mine do.

By the way, Keurig makes the Mr. Coffee Keurig machine so it's essentially the same machine just without all the bells and whistles. I am very pleased with my Mr.Coffee Keurig machine especially at the unbeatable price I got it at.
